data.summary:
Finance professional with 13 years of experience in Global Markets operations, Fund accounting, Securities pricing,
Reconciliation, Corporate Actions and P&L review with strong exposure to derivatives, valuations, pricing controls
and regulatory reporting. Proven track record in strengthening valuation governance, improving controls, and collaborating with Front Office, Middle Office, Back Office, Risk & Audit teams. Skilled in Independent Pricing Reviews, NAV Calculation
and validation, pricing variance investigation and automation initiatives improving operational efficiency and risk
mitigation. Demonstrated leadership in guiding teams, enhancing processes, and delivering accurate financial reporting in high- pressure environments.

Professional Summary
Finance professional with 13 years of experience in Global Markets operations, Fund accounting, Securities pricing,
Reconciliation, Corporate Actions and P&L review with strong exposure to derivatives, valuations, pricing controls
and regulatory reporting. Proven track record in strengthening valuation governance, improving controls, and collaborating with Front Office, Middle Office, Back Office, Risk & Audit teams. Skilled in Independent Pricing Reviews, NAV Calculation
and validation, pricing variance investigation and automation initiatives improving operational efficiency and risk
mitigation. Demonstrated leadership in guiding teams, enhancing processes, and delivering accurate financial reporting in high- pressure environments.

raw_sections.experience:
Professional Experience
Team Leader - Middle Office/Portfolio Controller
Nov 2019 - May 2025
State Street Services Pvt. Ltd.
Bangalore / Hyderabad
Performed daily NAV calculations, validated fund performance, and ensured accuracy in financial reporting across
multiple portfolios.
Supported the trade lifecycle by validating trade activity, pricing, subscriptions, redemptions, and settlement impact to ensure
accurate portfolio valuation and NAV calculation.
Reviewed Portfolio Accounting-to-custodian reconciliations, investigated breaks, and collaborated with Account
Managers to ensure timely resolution.
Conducted detailed P&L variance analysis, monitored FX funding requirements, and verified client subscriptions
and redemptions.
Processed OTC derivatives and complex securities, ensuring accurate pricing and corporate action validation in line
with market data.
Managed daily and monthly accruals for management fees, financing costs, and other fund expenses, ensuring
completeness and accuracy.
Partnered with global operations and middle-office teams to enhance NAV validation controls and improve
reconciliation efficiency.
Streamlined middle-office operations, strengthened Operational Control Framework (OCF) compliance, and
minimized reconciliation discrepancies.
Supported audit and compliance processes by providing key financial data, reconciliations, and documentation for
financial statement preparation.
Process Improvements & Audit Readiness: Optimized reconciliation cycles using PLM, TLM, RKS, advanced Excel, and
automation tools, reducing manual effort and accelerating month-end close timelines.
Mentored and trained junior analysts, fostering team development and maintaining high standards of performance and
client service.
Senior Associate – Corporate Actions / Fund Accounting
Dec 2011 - Dec 2017
State Street Syntel Services
Mumbai
• Led Corporate Actions Team: Supervised a team of analysts managing US/Canada corporate actions (both mandatory
and voluntary), ensuring high accuracy in event processing and improving response turnaround time.
• Process Transformation & Training: Successfully transitioned key operations from US Feeds to SWIFT messaging,
developed comprehensive SOPs, and trained team members, resulting in greater processing efficiency and enhanced audit
readiness.
NAV Calculation & Reporting: Calculated Net Asset Value (NAV) for multiple funds and prepared daily MIS reports
for senior leadership, helping reduce reporting errors and supporting effective decision-making.
Corporate Action Processing: Managed end-to-end processing of mandatory corporate action events across global equity and fixed income markets, including cash dividends, mergers, stock splits, tender offers, and rights issues.
Handled Full Call events as part of mandatory corporate actions for fixed income securities such as bonds and notes. • Verified and processed issuer notifications for full redemption of securities prior to maturity due to call provisions.
Ensured accurate capture of call details including record date, pay date, redemption amount, interest component,
and call price.
Ensured all events complied with market deadlines and internal control standards, minimizing risk and operational
losses.
Technology & Systems Expertise: Utilized Bloomberg, Swift, DTC, and MCH platforms to track, validate, and
execute mandatory and voluntary events across global markets, ensuring complete audit compliance and transparent
exception handling.
Financial Analysis & Compliance: Generated and reviewed financial reports with a focus on accuracy and
regulatory compliance, ensuring no compliance breaches and consistently strong internal audit results.
Multi-Asset Support & Analysis: Provided analytical and technical support across various asset classes including • equities, mutual funds, hedge funds, and bonds, enhancing data accuracy and delivering improved portfolio insights to clients.
Finance Executive Jun 2010 - Nov 2011
VKC Credit & Forex Service Pvt. Ltd. Pune
Accounts Payable/Receivable Management: Managed end-to-end Account Payable/ Account Receivable
functions, including reconciling bank and ledger accounts, ensuring accurate reconciliation and supporting smoother month-end
closing.
Audit & Compliance Support: Facilitated internal and external audits by maintaining accurate financial documentation and compliance, leading to smooth audit outcomes and enhanced financial transparency.
Cash Flow Monitoring: Monitored daily cash flow operations, strengthening liquidity forecasting and enabling
more informed financial planning decisions.
Tax Record Maintenance: Maintained accurate records for VAT, CST, and professional tax, ensuring timely filing
and compliance, which helped avoid penalties and supported accuracy in tax reporting.
